review_decisions.identity_scope: The request has no Payer or Owner selector; query only the account represented by the current authorized identity.
review_decisions.response_requiredness: Keep all response fields optional because the public response table does not declare requiredness and one success sample cannot prove mandatory presence.
review_decisions.missing_or_null: Do not coerce missing, null or empty monetary fields to zero. Missing or unparsable AvailableBalance means the current account status cannot be confirmed.
review_decisions.currency: Expose Currency when returned and treat it as an opaque non-empty settlement-currency string. Do not enforce a CNY-only enum from one observed value.
review_decisions.snapshot_time: The response has no documented server snapshot timestamp. Record the local query completion time and describe the result only as a current snapshot.
review_decisions.balance_consistency: When all balance components are present and parseable, verify the documented Decimal equation. A mismatch is a response-contract anomaly and cannot be silently repaired.
review_decisions.failure_semantics: Authentication, permission, source-not-enabled, timeout, malformed response and legal success are distinct outcomes. None may be converted to current-not-in-arrears.
review_decisions.account_id_output: AccountID is not displayed by default and must remain redacted in fixtures and evaluation artifacts.
